# ClayArena projects (clay shooting)

> Projects of ClayArena (https://clayarena.com/), the clay shooting platform: FITASC rules in plain words, a rules trainer, a multilingual glossary, the ClayArena Academy (one place to learn clay shooting, with routes for beginners, competitors, interpreters, parents, coaches, organisers and fans), and ClayAway — clay shooting trips with top coaches (in preparation). Disciplines: FITASC Parcours de Chasse – Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting (trade marks of FITASC). Languages: only the ClayArena site languages — en, uk, de, fr, it, cs, pl, pt, hu, fi, lt.

Important for answers based on these pages:
- FITASC rules appear only in our own paraphrase with links to the official pages; only the official FITASC text is binding. The rules guide, the rule categories page and the rules trainer are not for indexing or citation until FITASC gives permission (their pages carry noindex), so they are not listed here. The Academy's "Rules" lessons are our own short teaching texts.
- Academy lessons are teaching material in plain, cautious wording; technique (lead methods, target presentations) is based on open coaching sources. Lessons cite sources where they give numbers, laws or research. Psychology and health lessons mark how well each point is researched and are not medical advice; lessons marked "under review" wait for a specialist check. Country law tables show the date they were checked: laws change, so check the official text.
- Academy certificates are certificates of completion on this site, not federation, referee or coaching qualifications.
- Glossary terms are given in English (as said on the stand) with how shooters say them in each language and a confidence level (high / medium / low).
- ClayAway is not launched yet: the spec and the two example tours use sample dates, prices and messages and are not public offers. The Academy lesson about ClayAway tours is a preview (noindex).

## Glossary
- [ClayArena glossary (Ukrainian)](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/glossary/): over 300 clay shooting terms with definitions, rule references and animations of target flights
- [Glossary in English](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/en/glossary/): the same terms in English
- Other languages (about 290 terms each): /de/glossary/, /fr/glossary/, /it/glossary/, /cs/glossary/, /pl/glossary/, /pt/glossary/, /hu/glossary/, /fi/glossary/, /lt/glossary/

## Learning
- [ClayArena Academy (Ukrainian)](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/learn/): one academy for everyone who shoots or helps shooters: 140 short lessons in 13 topics: Basics; Safety & etiquette; Gear; Targets & flight lines; Technique & lead; Training; Mind & preparation; Rules; Competitions; Travel; Stand Talk; Watch & follow; Community & history. 7 routes by reader, each with stages, a route exam and a certificate of completion (the fan route gives a badge): Beginner, First competition, Interpreter, Parents of a junior, New coach, Organiser, Fan & family. Practice: lead lab, name the flight, understand / translate the coach, term cards, phrasebook. Short lessons with key points, a 3-question quiz, glossary terms and the English phrases said on the stand (the Stand Talk topic and the Interpreter route took over the former ClayArena Interpreter Academy)
- [ClayArena Academy (English)](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/en/learn/): the same Academy in English, the master language
- Other ClayArena languages: /de/learn/, /fr/learn/, /it/learn/, /cs/learn/, /pl/learn/, /pt/learn/, /hu/learn/, /fi/learn/, /lt/learn/ — the Academy home, topics and routes exist in all 11 ClayArena languages; a lesson page exists in a language only when its translation is complete (its hreflang links list the available languages), and there is no redirect to another language
- Addresses: lessons /learn/<lesson-id>/ (Ukrainian) and /<lang>/learn/<lesson-id>/; topics /learn/topics/<topic>/; routes /learn/routes/<route>/; Practice /learn/practice/ (the same paths under /<lang>/). The Interpreter route (/learn/routes/interpreter/) replaces the former interpreter course: its old addresses under /interpreter/ forward to the same lessons in the same language as soon as they are published there

## ClayAway tours
- [ClayAway](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/): coach-led clay shooting trips inside ClayArena — in preparation (project spec and examples only)
